# ✅ TEST CHECKLIST

After deploying to Netlify at:
https://vietnamtrainingpilotportfolio.netlify.app/

## Verify
- [ ] Site loads without errors
- [ ] Click 🎨 button (bottom-right)
- [ ] Switch themes → colors change
- [ ] Scroll sections → animations work
- [ ] Hero updates with theme
- [ ] Refresh page → theme persists
- [ ] All sections visible
- [ ] Text readable all themes
- [ ] Buttons clickable
- [ ] Page loads <3 seconds

## If Issues
1. Check browser console (F12)
2. Refresh page (Ctrl+F5)
3. Try different browser

## Support
All files in `/dist` folder are production-ready.
No additional setup needed.
